source_quote:
![critical](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/critical.svg)
> The trailing backslash `\` at the end of the command will escape the newline, causing a shell syntax error when the user copies and runs this script. Remove the trailing backslash since this is the last argument of the command.
fixed

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha c721319 体现修改

rule.description: 文档/教程中的多行 shell 命令，最后一行参数末尾不应有续行符 `\`，否则会转义换行符导致用户复制运行时出现语法错误。
checkpoints: 检查文档中多行 shell 命令的最后一行参数
确认最后一行末尾是否有不必要的 `\`
行末 `\` 仅用于续行（表示后面还有参数），最后一行应删除

antipattern.code:
docker run --rm \
        --device /dev/davinci0 \
        -v /mnt/share/models:/root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models \
        $IMAGE \
    vllm serve /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/UploadWeight/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-w4a8-test \
        --max-model-len 800000 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
        --speculative-config '{"method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 5, "enforce_eager": true}' \
        ```
    # ↑ 最后一个参数末尾有反斜杠 \，会转义换行符导致 shell 语法错误

pattern.code:
docker run --rm \
        --device /dev/davinci0 \
        -v /mnt/share/models:/root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models \
        $IMAGE \
    vllm serve /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/UploadWeight/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-w4a8-test \
        --max-model-len 800000 \
        --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
        --speculative-config '{"method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 5, "enforce_eager": true}'
        ```
    # ↑ 已删除末尾反斜杠，最后一个参数不需要续行符
